central_node: The Chair: Distinguishing True Friends from Fair-weather Peers
plot_summary_nodes: Mario boasts about having dozens of friends; his grandfather bets a bowl of fruit chaat that they aren't real.
Grandfather brings an invisible chair from the attic to test Mario's popularity.
At school, Mario tries to sit on the chair, missing it twice and falling while classmates laugh.
On his third attempt, Mario remains suspended because Guneet, Asma, and Deepa catch and hold him up.
character_arc_nodes: Mario: Boastful boy measuring friendship by headcount -> Wise child valuing loyal quality friends.
Grandfather: Wise elder using a clever practical test to teach a lifelong lesson.
Guneet, Asma, Deepa: Caring classmates who step forward to support Mario when he falls.
theme_and_moral_nodes: Primary Theme: Quality over quantity in friendship.
Moral Lesson: Real friends support you in times of trouble, whereas fair-weather friends merely laugh.
key_grammar_nodes: Suffixes (-ship, -ful, -ly): Forming new words from root words (friendship, boastful, friendly).
Root Words: Identifying base forms before affixation.
